role: Maps the repository's dependency graph across all workspace packages and exports it as an SBOM. Also flags external dependencies pinned to an unbounded version range, a real dependency-confusion attack surface.
behaviorDescription: Walks the repo for all package.json files (skipping node_modules/.git/build artifacts), builds a dependency graph of every declared dependency/devDependency edge, and flags any *external* (non-workspace) dependency pinned to '*' or 'latest' as a warn-severity finding — internal @platform/@features workspace packages using '*' are correctly excluded, since that is this repo's normal npm-workspaces linking convention, not a risk. generateSbom() produces a real, usable, unsigned SBOM today. signSbom() is an honest stub: it throws a clear error rather than faking a signature, because SBOM signing requires @platform/pqcrypto, which has not been built in this repo yet (CrystalForge Guardian AppSpec Phase 1 prerequisite).
hardStops: Never writes to, deletes, or modifies any file — detection and export only
Never flags internal workspace packages (@platform/*, @features/*) pinned to '*' — only external dependencies
signSbom() never fakes or silently skips a signature — it throws a clear error until @platform/pqcrypto exists
